content:
maria: Heads up — month-end reconcile fail for ACME-123. Invoice INV-2026-02-28 shows 1,324,512 tokens billed but dashboard export is 1,210,834. ~ $1,200 difference. Can someone dig into ingestion / proration / meter mapping?
kevin: Oof. Did they change plans mid-month or any plan migration events?
maria: Not per the account notes. Quick SQL I ran: 
```sql
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id='acme-123' AND ts >= '2026-02-01' AND ts < '2026-03-01';
-- result: 1,210,834
```
Invoice line (LN-998) shows 1,324,512 tokens.
samira: tagging infra/ingest — @jeff @kevin could APAC replay/backfill have been counted twice?
billing-bot: ingestion-run COMPLETE for 2026-02-28 region:apac backlog_processed=15800 files=3
jeff: I pulled logs — there is a long-running streaming session on Feb 27 that has replay=true in the event metadata. session_id=xyz123 replay=true tokens=110678. Might explain the delta if dedupe failed.
kevin: maria — can you paste the exact export command you used for the dashboard numbers?
maria: used admin export: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/usage/export \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"account":"acme-123","start":"2026-02-01","end":"2026-02-28","group_by":"meter_id"}' > export.csv
```
CSV shows meter breakdown: 
- rtx-gpt: 1,210,834 tokens
- context-ld: 0
invoice generator shows meter:gpt-token (mapped -> rtx-gpt) but also includes context-ld values aggregated under a different code.
samira: I'm seeing +112,678 tokens in the raw S3 bucket for apac that were re-ingested during the Feb 28 backfill window. The dedupe pipeline did not tag a replay_id for three files.
jeff: also dug into meter mapping history — mapping change deployed 2026-02-26 03:12 UTC that renamed meter "gpt-token" -> "rtx-gpt" and added aliasing. The invoices job may be reading from the legacy mapping cache if it started before the migration completed.
accounting-ops: FYI customer upgraded from STARTUP -> GROWTH on Feb 20 22:05 PST. Proration should be applied; invoice currently lists a single GROWTH SKU for full month (no prorate line).
kevin: summary hypothesis: 1) ingestion replay caused +112,678 tokens, 2) invoice generator mapping/proration bug incorrectly attributed or double-counted some meters and ignored plan effective_from. Action items: create billing ticket, pause invoices for ACME until root cause confirmed.
maria: created ticket #BILL-4521 with CSVs, invoice PDF, logs, and the SQL export.
samira: running a targeted reconcile diff now: comparing raw events -> meter-aggregation -> invoice generator. Preliminary diff matches the extra 112,678 tokens coming from apac replay files with null replay_id. Dedupe job didn't mark them so aggregator counted them. Patch coming to add null-check and run id dedupe.
jeff: I found a bug in invoice generator: when plan change event exists during month the generator picks latest plan enum instead of checking plan.effective_from and computing prorated lines. Opened PR: https://git.internal/repo/PR-4487 (fix + unit tests).
accounting-ops: hold on issuing final invoice for ACME until fix & reconciled amounts verified. If confirmed, apply provisional credit equal to the overcharge and reissue.
sam: I'll notify the customer: "We're investigating a billing discrepancy and will issue a provisional credit if needed. Will follow up within 24 hours." :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks. I attached diffs and sample log lines in #BILL-4521. Waiting on infra patch + PR merge.
kevin: ETA for fixes?
samira: dedupe patch deployed to staging now, running on subset. If green, deploy to prod in ~3h.
jeff: invoice-gen PR needs code review; hoping to merge by EOD and run a dry-run invoice generation.
maria: great — I'll keep ticket updated and coordinate reissue once we have reconciled totals. Appreciate the quick response.
accounting-ops: noted. Please ensure final credit line shows as "provisional_credit" so downstream AR reconciles correctly.
